title: Garlicky {p} with {v}
steps: Warm the {sauce} in a large skillet over medium heat with the {spice} and a few slices of garlic for about a minute, until fragrant.
Add the {p} (canned beans only need draining and rinsing; dried beans need soaking and boiling first) and toss in the garlic oil for 3 minutes, until hot.
Season with salt, then serve over the {s} with the {v}.
tip: Use more spinach than you think you need. It cooks down to almost nothing.
